item.title: OpenAI Adopts Google's SynthID Watermark for AI Images with Verification Tool
item.description:
📝 May 19, 2026SafetyAdvancing content provenance for a safer, more transparent AI ecosystemHelping people understand the origin of AI-generated content through Content Credentials, SynthID, and an early public verification tool. A multi-layered approach to provenance with Google SynthID for imagesC2PA metadata is an important foundation for provenance. C2PA helps content carry detailed context; SynthID helps preserve a signal when metadata does not survive.
🔗 Read more: https://openai.com/index/advancing-content-provenance/

item.title: Dumb Ways for an Open Source Project to Die
item.description:
📝 The maintainer left Ghost maintainer. The maintainer is still there Burnout plateau. There’s often just enough response that anyone who suggests forking gets pointed at the recent activity but never enough to actually ship, and it can hold that shape for years without being quite dead enough for anyone to feel justified taking over.
🔗 Read more: https://nesbitt.io/2026/05/19/dumb-ways-for-an-open-source-project-to-die.html
